assessments.reasoning: JLS SE 21 §10.2 fixes the count of components for the lifetime of each array object. The same paragraph explains how a variable can later refer to an array with a different count.

challenge.method: Consider reassigning an array variable to a longer array or writing a component of the original array.
challenge.results: Reassignment changes which object the variable designates. A component write changes a stored value. Neither operation changes the original object's length.

limitations: This applies to an array object's length. Array components and assignable references are separate.
The rule fixes the component count of each individual array object after creation.
